item.title: London Gets First Permanent Pokémon Store Outside Asia
item.description: Pokémon Company will open a permanent London store by 2029, the first outside Asia, offering exclusive merch and marking a new global retail milestone.

item.title: Apple Stores Get Do‑Not‑Open Boxes for Smart Home
item.description: Apple stores worldwide got sealed 'Do Not Open Until Oct 8' boxes, signaling a coordinated launch of Smart Home Hub and updated devices on Oct 13.

item.title: Apple Moves Four U.S. Stores in July – Impact Explained
item.description: Apple is moving four U.S. stores—in New York, Mississippi, Michigan, and Colorado—to new mall spots this July, signaling evolving retail strategy.
